answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 17003 Country: Pakistan Title: Aas Salaamoalaikum, One of my relative son died at the age of 27 leaving behind two sisters and his parents. One of the sister was married before his dead while the younger one is marrying now. He came into dream of the younger sister wearing black suit and a red tie and telling her that she is getting married. While at the same time one of the cousin also informed that her daughter also dream of his uncle wearing the black suit and a red tie and also tells her his younger sister is getting married. Can you please inform us what is the meaning of his coming in the dream and what is the sign of wearing black suit and a red tie. His father always pray for him on Fridays and sometimes visit the grave too. Will appreciate to receive your replies soon. Question: Aas Salaamoalaikum, One of my relative son died at the age of 27 leaving behind two sisters and his parents. One of the sister was married before his dead while the younger one is marrying now. He came into dream of the younger sister wearing black suit and a red tie and telling her that she is getting married. While at the same time one of the cousin also informed that her daughter also dream of his uncle wearing the black suit and a red tie and also tells her his younger sister is getting married. Can you please inform us what is the meaning of his coming in the dream and what is the sign of wearing black suit and a red tie. His father always pray for him on Fridays and sometimes visit the grave too. Will appreciate to receive your replies soon. Answer ID: 17003 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2040/1621/D=1430) Marriage should be free from things which are prohibited in Shariya and it should be done according to the Sunnah. And, one should try to keep himself away from westernism in living. The suit and tie indicate the evils present at home. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
